_about: How Priva report headers map to our column names. To support a new report or a renamed field, edit this file, not the code. Header text is matched case-insensitively with spaces trimmed. 'text' lists measures kept as words (not added up); clock times (e.g. 06:14) are read as hours. Any 'employee_name' column is replaced by the employee number before anything is stored.

_not_used._about: Report titles the app recognises but does not use yet, with the reason shown to the user. Not an error.
_not_used.Performance: Per-person summary with names but no employee numbers or dates. The R&D Analytics export has the same work per registration, with employee numbers.
_not_used.Performance (tactical): Totals for one filtered selection only (19,259 h for '2026'). Use Production for site-wide hours.
_not_used.Climate (tactical): Climate is outside the labour plan for now.
_not_used.Quality Evaluation: Quality ratings (strawberries only, one evaluator). Kept for later; not used in the plan yet.
_not_used.Reader scan log: Scanner activity per reader. Not needed for the plan.
_not_used.Weighing log: Harvest weighings with no date, person or row. The yield report (Production tactical) is used instead.

performance.description: Priva Operational Report, Performance template (labour registrations per activity / location / employee). Also the R&D Analytics exports.

production.description: Priva Operational Report, Production template: hours, result and area per activity group / activity / location for a period. Covers every activity on site.

hours.description: Priva Operational Report, Hours template: paid, present and registered hours per employee, by weekday, for a period.
